one_liner: Pylon is a B2B support platform with a REST API using admin-created bearer tokens and an official MCP server (OAuth or API token). API access sits on paid seat plans, and trials are arranged through sales.
auth_notes: The REST API uses a bearer API token created by an Admin in Settings. Tokens don't expire and have no separate scopes; the role controls access. Two regions (US and EU) with matching base URLs. OAuth 2.0 is documented only for the MCP server, not for the REST API.
access_notes: The pricing table lists API under the paid Professional plan ($89 per seat/month, annual contract). Torii's guide says a plan with API access (Professional, Advanced or Enterprise) is required. Pylon has no free plan. Free trials exist but are set up with a sales representative, so they are not self-serve. The facts page's corrections table says the REST API is available on every plan, which conflicts with the pricing table, so access confidence is low.
blocker_notes: Needs a paid Pylon workspace (or a sales-arranged trial) and an Admin to create the token. Each customer must create and paste their own token, and the region must match. The sandbox is Enterprise only. The vendor's own pages conflict on whether the API is on every plan.

evidence.quote: Only Admins can create and manage API tokens.
